local_guard_rejection.meaning: MOTION_HAZARD: checked footprint intersects a lethal cell
local_guard_rejection.note: Counters count rejected proposals; console output is buffered/spliced and its read timestamps are not exact control-cycle timestamps.

code_gaps.finding: Rejected motion clears the route, but only GOTO changes to ST_BLOCKED. SEARCH remains ST_SEARCHING.
SEARCH changes goals after 12 seconds; no rejection-driven immediate alternative route/goal handling. Goal changes did occur in this run.
Stall recovery depends on measured displacement; zero-command drift / pose corrections can keep resetting progress. n_stall remains zero in this run; this mechanism is plausible, not uniquely proved.
Active target tasks do not immediately terminate/report control sensor faults or inactive balance. Later target-loss is described as continuing exploration despite control being inactive.

not_determined: Which local lethal cells caused the rejection: no historical local grid / rejected-cell coordinates were saved.
Whether those cells were true cardboard/support obstacles, erroneous lidar cells, or a swept-command/corner constraint.
Why BMI088 failed electrically, or whether it followed a user power/stop action.
recommended_changes: Preserve footprint collision rejection; feed its blocked segment/cell into replan and select another reachable exploration goal after a bounded wait.
Report blocked in SEARCH and show the reason and retry state in the bridge/UI.
On fresh control feedback reporting IMU failure / stop latch / balance inactive, stop issuing search motion and report the control fault promptly.
Store a bounded snapshot of the first rejected footprint/cells and pose for future attribution without additional vehicle trials.
